meta.title: Quote Mode (Discount % or Price): refused for a user without the Vendor role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Vendor role on the specified Enterprise tenant and verify that Quote Mode (Discount % or Price) is refused or absent.
Repeat the Quote Mode action as a Vendor on the same tenant and verify that discount-percentage and absolute-price quoting is available.
Verify the tenant's Enterprise plan or determine whether RBAC intentionally grants Quote Mode to additional roles.
